description: 跨 agent 的待办清单：在 pane-remote 里跑的 agent 经 MCP 记下要你处理或之后要做的事，手机上查看、勾掉、编辑

features.explain: 把输入的文字记成一条待办

add.description: Add an item to the user's shared todo list (shown on their phone, shared by every agent they run). Use it for things the user should see or act on later: follow-ups you could not finish, decisions waiting for the user, reminders, known issues to revisit. Not a replacement for your own short-lived task list; add only items worth keeping after this session. The calling agent, pane and working directory are recorded automatically.

title.description: one line, in the user's language

note.description: details: context, links, file paths, what is left to do

project.description: absolute project path; defaults to your working directory

list.description: List items on the user's shared todo list. Check it before adding to avoid duplicates, or when the user asks what is pending.

project.description: "current" = your working directory (and below), an absolute path, or "all" (default)

query.description: substring search in title and note

update.description: Change a todo item (title, note, priority, tags, project, or status open/done).

done.description: Mark a todo item as done (or reopen it with reopen: true), optionally appending a short note about how it was resolved.

note.description: appended to the note, e.g. what was done

remove.description: Delete a todo item permanently. Only when the user asks for it or the item was added by mistake; finished work should be marked done instead.
